description: A hiring tracker built with SvGrid Base, a table database component for Svelte 5: a Candidates table and a Roles table as tabs, linked both ways. Candidates have a photo, the role, the stage, a recruiter, a rating, an interview date, a salary ask and a resume; each role lists its candidates. Views for the hiring pipeline as a Kanban, all candidates, a gallery of faces, the interview calendar and an application form.

faq.question: Is this a template or a component?
faq.answer: A component: <SvBase> with your rows and columns. Most of the demo is sample data; the views, the field editor, the record view and the form come with the component.

faq.question: Can candidates apply through it?
faq.answer: The Apply view is a form over the same fields: name, email, role, resume and notes. Submitting adds a candidate in the Applied stage, the way + Add row does.

faq.question: Where do interviewers leave feedback?
faq.answer: Open a candidate (Space on a row, or click a card): the record lists every field and, beside them, the changes made and the comments, with a box for a new one.

faq.question: Which license does it need?
faq.answer: SvGrid Base is part of the Suite edition of @svgrid/enterprise. Without a key it runs with a watermark, so it can be evaluated as is.
